clips.title: The story
paras: North of Auberdine, Mist's Edge follows Darkshore's western shore beneath ocean fog. Gray beaches hold shipwrecks, great sea creature remains, crabs, and murlocs.

Mist's Edge runs along Darkshore's western edge, where damp sand and rocky tidepools lie beneath coastal fog. Shattered vessels, drift timber, and the remains of huge sea creatures litter the beach. Crabs forage along the shore, while murloc tribes make their homes in the surf.

Wreckage and discarded cargo line the sands where vessels have been lost in the waters off Darkshore. Night elf sentinels and scavengers watch the coast, as murloc encampments menace travelers making their way along the shore from Auberdine.
